supersedes: the first BTAD03_GEOMETRY_IMPACT run, whose mask pairing used the filename stem and therefore assigned defect masks to normal images
issue: the canonical BTAD-03 mask maps the original 800 columns onto the 588 canvas columns, while the encoder's canvas comes from an aspect-preserving resize to 597 columns followed by a top-left crop to 588
verdict: the two mask variants are the same transform family and differ only by the 1.5% horizontal scale induced by the crop; the reported deltas bound the registration effect on BTAD-03
